description: This PHP class 'EmployeeTerminationRecordDecorator' serves as a decorator for the EmployeeTerminationRecord entity in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to access and modify termination record data, including formatting dates and setting termination reasons by ID.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationRecordDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class providing additional functionalities and abstractions around the EmployeeTerminationRecord entity, including date formatting and termination reason assignment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a specific EmployeeTerminationRecord entity.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Retrieves the termination date from the entity, formatted as a string using a helper trait.

methods.name: setTerminationReasonById
methods.description: Assigns a TerminationReason entity to the record based on a provided ID.
